sourceRefs.locator: Introduction, opening paragraphs through note 4. Odoacer in 476, the eastern emperor Zeno’s mandate, the Italian campaign in 489, the agreement and killing in 493, and Theoderic’s death in 526.
Paragraphs around notes 84–88. Athalaric, his minority and his mother Amalasuentha’s regency, the accession letters and the promised continuation of rights.
Discussion of Witigis and Belisarius, paragraphs around notes 113–120. Surrender of Ravenna in 540 and its continued imperial control during the remaining war.

summary.de: Das Königreich bestand über Theoderichs Tod hinaus. Ravenna blieb bis zur Einnahme durch Belisar 540 ein Sitz des Königshofs. Der Krieg ging in anderen Teilen Italiens weiter.
summary.en: The kingdom survived Theoderic’s death. Ravenna remained a seat of the royal court until Belisarius took the city in 540. The war continued elsewhere in Italy.
